Hi Lina — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few quick items so we can get you into our system cleanly: 

1) Legal name verification: please confirm that "Nova Medical Supplies LLC" is the exact name shown on your W-9 (it looks consistent but we need a strict match for tax records).

2) Entity status: our tax team flags single-member LLCs differently for 1099 workflows. Confirm if you operate under any DBA or alternative tax classification.

3) Remit address: we need a separate remit address only if payment remittance is mailed — you indicated ACH so we'll use the primary business address. Confirm if remittance emails should go to ap@novamedical.com.

4) Banking: for ACH we require a bank letter or voided check (bank letter received). Please do NOT email full bank account numbers in reply — we will follow up with a secure upload link if we need the account numbers captured in our AP system.

5) Vendor questionnaire: please complete the short questionnaire at the link below — it helps us set tax codes and PO routing.
   https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cVendorProfile

6) PO cadence and terms: our standard is net 30 unless otherwise negotiated. Can you confirm you accept PO-based orders and can accommodate blanket POs for recurring shipments?

Once we have the confirmations + the questionnaire completed, Karthik will create the vendor record and assign a vendor code. I'll follow up with the initial PO.

Thanks — looping Karthik and Hannah for the setup and any insurance/COI needs (Hannah, can you flag COI requirements for supplies?).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

- PO process: our Procurement team issues a PO in Coupa (vendor receives an automated PO email). Vendor should confirm PO acceptance by email (PO number in subject) and reference PO on invoices.
- Remittance: AP will send remittance advices to the address/email provided once payments are processed. Our AP team needs the vendor code to route payments, so please let me know when the profile is created.

Marissa — create vendor profile with the legal name exactly as on the W-9 and set tax profile to "US - 1099" pending tax team confirmation. Hannah — please review COI threshold (we typically require supplier COIs for medical goods handled in warehouses).
